patch.value: Restore disposable cleanup force and primary-error contracts

Separate generic caller-owned scratch cleanup from persistent namespace retirement. Review threads PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzbn, PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzbs, PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzcF, PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzcW, PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzce and PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzci identify valid cleanup-ledger, primary-error masking and force semantics concerns in installer, privacy, fetch, bisect and self-host helpers and durability.remove. These general API/scratch-lifetime contracts extend beyond this PR native pack/erasure provenance fix; gate-owned scratch cleanup already bounds CI storage. The current repair supplies a direct disposable helper for the in-scope benchmark and partial fragment output, without changing persistent retirement authority.

Disposable caller-owned scratch creates no persistent retirement ledger; Cleanup failures retain the original operation error and exact ownership boundaries; force false preserves fresh ENOENT while force true and authorized recovery retain their documented behavior; Real non-git installer privacy fetch bisect and self-host failure fixtures verify the contracts
